categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Xuerong Biotechnology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, factory-based cultivation, and sales of fresh edible mushrooms. Its main products include enoki mushrooms (accounting for 65.84% of business), shimeji mushrooms (including crab-flavored, white jade, and seafood mushrooms), king oyster mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, and deer antler mushrooms. The company operates multiple production bases across China and has expanded into Southeast Asia with subsidiaries in Thailand, Vietnam, and Malaysia.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs modern biotechnology and factory-based cultivation methods, utilizing controlled environments with temperature, humidity, airflow, and light regulation to simulate optimal ecological conditions for mushroom growth. Production is mechanized, standardized, and year-round, focusing on improving strain quality through proprietary breeding and hybridization technologies. It holds 59 patents, including 21 invention patents, and operates a key national laboratory for edible mushroom strain research.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Xuerong serves distributors, supermarket chains, chain restaurants, and fresh food delivery platforms primarily in China, with growing sales in Southeast Asian markets. Its products cater to food retailers and foodservice sectors, targeting consumers seeking high-quality fresh edible mushrooms. The company’s sales are mainly domestic (over 90%), with international sales accounting for about 9.66%.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has strategically located production bases in multiple Chinese provinces including Jilin, Shandong, Guangdong, Sichuan, Guizhou, Gansu, Guangxi, and Jiangsu, as well as an overseas production base in Thailand. It has also established trading subsidiaries in Vietnam and Malaysia to expand its international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Xuerong Biotechnology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the edible mushroom supply chain, focusing on the cultivation and production of fresh mushrooms. It sources agricultural by-products as raw materials for mushroom substrate preparation and sells finished fresh mushroom products downstream to distributors and retailers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes strengthening its core competitiveness through continuous R&D in mushroom strain breeding, hybridization, and preservation techniques. It aims to improve product quality, reduce costs via substrate formula optimization, and enhance production stability across bases. Xuerong also focuses on expanding capacity, brand promotion, and exploring new sales models and markets, including Southeast Asia.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of fresh edible mushrooms via a buyout sales model to distributors and direct sales to supermarkets and foodservice chains. The company also earns income from sales of cultivation substrates, materials, mushroom beverages, and leasing activities. Sales are mostly cash or credit-based with limited receivables exposure.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xuerong is the largest factory-based edible mushroom producer in China by capacity, holding a leading market position with a nationwide production and sales network. It competes with other large-scale mushroom producers such as Jiangsu Hualv Biotechnology and Fujian Wancheng Biotechnology. The company leverages its technological, scale, and brand advantages to maintain and grow market share amid intense industry competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.565 billion, a 10.55% increase year-over-year, but reported a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 188 million due to market price declines and increased sales expenses. It operates with total assets of about RMB 4.6 billion and has been expanding production capacity with significant capital investments in new industrial parks. Cash flow from operations remains positive at around RMB 360 million.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xuerong emphasizes high-quality, safe, and nutritious fresh edible mushrooms produced through advanced factory-based cultivation technology. Its nationwide production layout ensures fresh supply close to markets, enhancing product freshness and reducing logistics costs. Proprietary strains, patented cultivation methods, and a strong brand reputation contribute to product differentiation and customer trust.
